title: 完整用户目录及用户上下文操作

requirement.verbatim: 完整用户管理：按全局用户去重提供分页、筛选、搜索、详情和企业成员关系，含注册与登录、状态、费用、VIP、任务及内容入口；联系资料按字段授权展示，不把多企业成员算作多个用户。

review.method: Read-only static UI to API to authorization to SQL review; no services, tests, browser, product modifications or push.

what_implementation_demands: A globally unique, authorized user directory with server pagination and usable search/filter/detail, scoped memberships and identity metadata, and working user-context fee/VIP/task/content operations; contact read and search must be field-authorized. The related dashboard specification requires preserved URL filters.

findings.title: User detail loses the selected user in VIP and fee operations
findings.root_cause: UserDetail spreads the response envelope into BillingModal.user. The response has user.id, but BillingModal reads props.user.id. An any prop hides this shape error.
fee_path: backend preserves account read authorization but omits selected-user predicate
findings.static_reproduction: With valid Admin access and required permissions, select any directory user and open Grant VIP or Manage credit. Trace actual detail response and props. No UI run was performed.
findings.limits: No privilege escalation or wrong-user financial mutation was demonstrated. Browser validation wording is unobserved.

findings.title: User detail has no selected-user task/content entry
findings.exhaustive_scope: Read entire UserDetail return tree and every local action. Searched Link/navigate/tasks/content/execution/billing/entitle/Operation in that function. Only a back Link and unrelated actions exist; task match is a count. Followed alternative general Section API query, generic pagination schema and content projection; none preserves selected-user context.
findings.limits: General task and content administration pages exist; their mere presence is not a contextual user entry.

findings.title: Directory search/filter state is not preserved in the URL
findings.static_reproduction: Apply a user/state/VIP filter, open a user detail and return or reload the directory. Applied filters were only component state; route effect resets them and the back Link uses /users.
findings.limits: Backend filtering for supported parameters is present; this finding is frontend persistence.

paths_walked: Section directory query -> GET /v1/admin/users -> requireAdmin -> readScope/current bindings/MFA -> scoped users SQL -> per-user DTO/memberships -> signed cursor -> page controls
Directory filter/search -> strict userQuery -> filter field authorization -> scoped SQL predicates -> UI state without URL persistence
User row -> UserDetail -> GET /users/:user_id and /management-context -> scoped identity/memberships/usage/entitlements
UserDetail -> BillingModal -> VipCommandModal -> readOnly required missing subject
UserDetail -> BillingModal -> CanonicalFeeModal -> billing accounts -> readScope -> optional subject predicate absent
UserDetail full return tree -> no task/content entry; alternate general pages -> no selected-user filter contract

searched.result: Found exact REQ-084 and dashboard details; historical gaps were not treated as current source evidence.
data-jobs.tsx, deletions.tsx and provider-control.tsx only; none in directory path
Only Link is back to /users; task match is count; fee/VIP modal references traced; no task/content link or panel.
Account collection path has optional subject filter at L82-L83.
Normal user login writes auth.ts:L394; directory DTO reads source field.
File did not exist; corrected to actual auth.ts. Not counted as 0-hit absence evidence.

how_verdict_was_reached: Implemented core identity, deduplication, supported filtering, cursor pagination, detail and field authorization rule out absent. Broken selected-user fee/VIP target plus missing task/content entry and URL persistence prevent implemented. Overall design is aligned, so partial rather than globally contradicted.
open_questions: No UI/API execution. Browser-native validation message is unobserved; static prop mismatch is proven.

Expanded dashboard filters (registration/activity, VIP type/expiry, spend ranges, low balance) are not represented by the current strict schema; no claim of their implementation or exhaustive subfeature audit.
All federated/native login timestamp semantics were not individually reviewed.
Account and membership mutation state machines require their own review; existing entry buttons are not proof of mutation correctness.
A future task/content link alone cannot close F084-02 unless destination UI and API enforce the same selected-user context.
